title: Parent settings for one child in one game
description: A desired state. The game fetches it at the main menu or the map (never mid-level) and makes itself match. Per field, the latest change wins: the server sets rev and at on every write, from the parent app or from the tablet's Grown-ups panel. A game ignores keys it does not know; keys come from the game's manifest.

fields.description: key -> {value, rev, at, by}. by is "parent" (with the adult's id later) or "device:<dev>".
